programmes.d: Deep within a forest on the US-Canadian border, two sworn enemies must work together to escape a ruthless drug cartel hell-bent on retrieving a drug shipment which went missing there.

Based on the true story of a newly married FBI agent (Jack Huston) who is drawn into an illicit affair with his star informant (Emilia Clarke), resulting in a murder scandal that lead to the first ever conviction of a federal agent.
